[Package]
Name="ni_lib_simple_n_net"
Version="3.1.0.9"
Release=""
ID=3fc237235131de4e6303e93b4b8142c7
File Format="vip"
Format Version="2017"
Display Name="Simple Neural Network"


[Description]
Description="This toolkit is designed to be used for super simple neural network use cases. It is not designed for any advanced AI aplications but should be used as a starting point, evaluation or proof of concept for further development. \0A\0AThe only teaching algorithm supported is RProp because of it's independance from the settings and universality.\0A\0AThe features of the toolkit:\0A\0A- feedforward neural network with sigmoidal unipolar activation function\0A- automatic linear scaling of inputs and outputs to the linear range of the neurons for optimum performance\0A- option to enable last layer linear activation function\0A- BIAS inputs for each layer for optimum performance\0A- two hidden layers with automatic number of neurons\0A- RProp teaching algorithm\0A- teaching in chunks from a human readable TDMS file\0A- evaluating errors over validation set\0A- percentage error evaluation on each output\0A- saving and loading the network from huma readable file\0A- documentation\0A- XOR tester\0A\0ANOTE - this is a super simple neural network and it should be used only in simple cases :)\0A\0ATHE CODE IS OPEN so you can use it to learn how Neural Nets work or modify it to your needs."
Summary="Easy to use neural networks toolkit."
License="NewBSD"
Copyright="Copyright (c) 2020, Piotr Kruczkowski"
Distribution=""
Vendor="Piotr Kruczkowski"
URL="https://github.com/Primary-Key/Simple-Neural-Network"
Packager="Piotr Kruczkowski"
Demo="FALSE"
Release Notes="- changed the structure of NN when saved to file. It is now saved to an INI filie and can be easily edited.\0A- changed the teaching file to be TDMS based. This will make it easier to create and view files.\0A- simplified the API and made it even faster to use"
